behavior: The owner can cancel an invoice or request before any money arrives; it never settles and later money is held for the payer (PLAN 9.5)
acceptance: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/cancel marks an open invoice (every option) with no recorded deposit and an open checkout canceled with its time and answers 409 invoice_not_cancelable otherwise; a canceled invoice never settles and a later deposit is booked as held for the payer; backend tests cover it, including a deposit before the cancel and a payer-chooses invoice (R-79)
The owner page's quiet Cancel invoice (Cancel request) link opens a confirm dialog naming the number and the consequences, with Keep invoice and a danger Cancel invoice, and a toast after (R-79)

The pay page says the payee canceled it and not to send money, with no address or QR, and money that still arrives is held for the payer; the Invoices and Requests lists, their Canceled filter, Activity and the invoice PDF (no pay link or code) say Canceled (R-79)
notes: 2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: PASS. Money safe: Final() includes canceled, so Process books every deposit to payer_held (split final=true), status() never leaves canceled, no settlement intent is queued, signer check() refuses non-paid, ProcessChain only picks canceled rows with unbooked confirmed transfers, expiry path skipped, canary query excludes canceled. Option id cannot cancel (coalesce(main_id,id)=option id matches no row -> 404). Ran: go test ./internal/... ok; web vitest 123 ok; ui-web 38 ok; lint, typecheck, check-docs ok. Mutations on a scratch copy: Final without canceled, no status check, no expiry check, no transfer check, update main row only, PDF branch off, filter off -> all caught. Survived: (a) lock query without profile_id -> test still passes because GetOfProfile then 404s, but the other profile's invoice WAS canceled; invoices_cancel_test.go:281 should assert the other invoice is still open. (b) transfer check on the main row only -> no test has a transfer on a second option only. (c) reorged filter removed -> no test. Notes: 1) docs/backend/architecture.md:357 and state diagram still say paid/expired/expired_partially_paid are the only final statuses and the trigger rejects other changes; add canceled and open->canceled (owning-doc rule). 2) invoices.go:85 getProfileInvoice doc comment now sits on cancelInvoice. 3) Race: watcher inserts transfers without locking invoices, so a transfer committed between Cancel's EXISTS check and commit leaves a canceled invoice with a deposit; money is held for the payer, so safe, but R-79's 409 promise is best effort; say so in api.md. 4) Possible deadlock: Cancel locks group rows in scan order (main first likely) while Process(option) locks option then main; Postgres kills one, Cancel may 500. ORDER BY main_id (main last) in the lock query avoids it. 5) Web: on 409 RTK invalidates tags, the refetch hides CancelInvoice and the dialog with its tooLate alert vanishes; after success the dialog unmounts and focus drops to body; mutation error persists on reopen. 6) Pre-existing, not new: a held deposit to a canceled invoice raises the Payment detected toast and sits under Activity Paid filter (deposit status_filter). 7) Down migration fails if canceled rows exist (safe). 8) Property test does not cover canceled; openapi also adds network_unavailable (unrelated drift fix).

2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: PASS on 97d6c4e. Each earlier note checked: (1) invoices_cancel_test.go:52 checks another profile's invoice stays open; mutation dropping profile_id from the lock query now fails there. (2) TestCancelPayerChoosesInvoice puts a detected transfer on the second option only and expects 409; mutation limiting the transfer check to the main row now fails (line 88). (3) cancel.go lock query ORDER BY main_id IS NULL, id FOR UPDATE locks options then the main row, the same order as ledger Process (option, then main), so no lock cycle. (4) docs/backend/architecture.md lists canceled as final with the owner-only open->canceled step; api.md says a transfer seen at the same moment lands on a canceled invoice and is held. (5) A 409 now also raises a warning toast, which survives the refetch that removes the dialog; after success the effect focuses the status line once canceled has rendered and the dialog is unmounted; e2e asserts it. (6) getProfileInvoice comment is back above its function. Earlier mutations (Final without canceled, no status check) still fail. Ran at 97d6c4e: go test ./internal/invoice ./internal/httpapi/... ./internal/ledger ok; web vitest 123 passed; pnpm lint and typecheck ok; e2e not run by me. Earlier notes 6-8 do not block: 6 (held deposit raises Payment detected toast and sits under Activity Paid) is older behavior shared with expired invoices, worth its own task; 7 (down migration fails with canceled rows) is the safe outcome; 8 (property test without canceled, unrelated openapi network_unavailable enum fix) is minor. Small leftover: on a 409 while the dialog stays open, the user sees both the in-dialog alert and the toast.
